SELECT SEQ_TRIAL_INQUIRY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRIAL_INQUIRY ( INQUIRY_NO, MEMBER_NO, TRIAL_NO, BUSINESS_NO, SUBJECT, QUESTION, ANSWER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, ANSWERED_AT ) VALUES ( #{inquiryNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memberNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trialNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{businessNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{subject,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{question,jdbcType=CLOB}, NULL, 'WAITING', SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC, I.INQUIRY_NO DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND I.INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo}
